data.title: Specify typed SQL 0.2 contract
data.description: For bn-ndm8: review the additive sigil:sql/driver@0.2.0 public WIT, typed value and Lua projection semantics, query-versus-exec split, stateful resource, caller-lower result caps, deferred timeout rationale, exhaustive MySQL text-protocol mapping, PostgreSQL viability, immutable SQL 0.1 guard, digests, and generated Rust binding check. No release or driver implementation is included.

data.reason: LGTM at exact target 421d4cda672d2b724f9b69754588c36a418765d2. Verified nominal sigil:sql/driver@0.2.0 WIT parsing and Rust generation; lossless tagged NULL/s64/u64/f64/DECIMAL/text/bytes/temporal shapes with explicit temporal metadata; row-only query, command-only exec, stateful session and idempotent close semantics; caller ceilings are lower-only while host/operator byte and deadline authority remains controlling; frozen 0.1 is byte-identical at SHA256 1eed081d... and BLAKE3 62cb190b...; MySQL enum mapping is exhaustive; no imports, dependency changes, or authority expansion. just check and digest gates pass.
